arguments.description: 16x16 pixel art UI status icon meaning Ready / completed successfully: one bold checkmark silhouette, centered with a small margin, in a cool light-blue accent (around #70b9ed) with slightly lighter and deeper blue shading for form, high contrast against a dark navy UI panel (#172336). Clean hard-edged pixel clusters, simple readable shape at 1x, no text, no circle or badge behind the check, no spinner, arrows, cross or pause bars, transparent background.
